name: Pinkster Gin
production: Distilled in a stainless steel pot still (Thames Distillers, London)
Fresh raspberries steeped/macerated in the gin after distillation
No added sugar (under 1 g sugar per bottle per Gin Guild)
history: 2013 | Launched in June 2013; founded by Stephen Marsh (North Hertfordshire)
nose: Juniper followed by a delicate sweetness
palate: Juniper and raspberry in alternating waves
Faintly sweet, black-pepper spiced red berries
finish: Smooth with pepper notes in the tail
Cracked black pepper, raspberry cream soda
serve_official: Collins glass, plenty of ice, Indian tonic water, a raspberry and a sprig of mint (Gin Guild)
notes: botanical_count 5 per Difford's Guide (other three botanicals not named). Only juniper + raspberry named in sources. Producer website not fetched.
